annotations.text: Desktop, first run. One question: is this the machine that stays on? Left card installs hub + node + tmux and lands on Hub ready. Right card is the client path and lands on Connect to a hub. Both end in the Workspace.

Hub ready is also the hand-off to the phone: the code on screen is what Phone · Welcome scans. The address dropdown replaces today's OFFDESK_BASE_URL env var. Get-the-app buttons are placeholders until the App Store link exists.
Menu bar popover on the hub machine only. Same items as `offdesk-hub link`, `service`, and Add host, but visible. Close the window and the hub keeps running as a service.

Phone. Welcome → scan → list → terminal. Can't reach the hub is the screen the app shows instead of a blank WebView when the LAN address times out; it names the two iOS switches the README already documents.

Style: the site's sand / cream / coral / sun palette, Fredoka display + Nunito body + Geist Mono. Terminals stay night-dark. The app's current dark-only chrome is intentionally not matched here; that is the change being proposed.
